card.name: Final zero in round numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 0 (rarely 2) that ends a multi-digit number, usually the last digit of 1000, 600, 150 or 100 in ranges, doses and rates. It fires when a number is being completed.

modes.label: Trailing zero in dose or count
modes.description: The last 0 of a number like 1000, 600 or 1500 before a unit such as mL, mg or patients.
